findings.detail: The normalized position identity drops the source (l) versus (q) discriminator and collapses two distinct Lightspeed positions into one duplicate key.

rationale: B02 is a real identity-key defect. Raw source table 12 separately discloses two Lightspeed Solutions term-loan rows with different source markers, par amounts, costs, and fair values. The extracted key described by the flag omits that row-level discriminator, so two genuine positions collide. Remediation must preserve a distinguishing identity attribute; the rows must not simply be deduplicated.
